_note: v2.8 plan 52 (no-model lane): reaching a checkpoint latches a codex fact ({reached}) that the player projection (game.codex, the Journal's Places page source) then shows; a reopen keeps it; a swipe of the reply that reached the checkpoint takes it away; a second reopen equals the replayed state. assert-player-clean in player mode. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-52-codex.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); return { cleared: ctx.chat.length === 0 };

import_story.title: SO-V28-52 Codex
import_story.description: Plan 52 no-model fixture: a place fact learned on reaching the tower.

qualities.rubric: Has the party reached the old tower?

facts.text: The tower bell has no clapper.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(200); } }; const FACT = 'The tower bell has no clapper.'; const codex = () => JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().game?.codex ?? null); const known = () => codex().includes(FACT); const saved = async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 100 && rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null; i += 1) await pause(100); if (rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null) throw new Error('the last boundary is not saved'); }; const reopen = async () => { const chatId = SillyTavern.getContext().chatId; await SillyTavern.getContext().reloadCurrentChat(); await until(() => rt.getSnapshot().storyId === 'so-v28-52-codex', 10000, 'the story to hydrate after the reopen'); if (SillyTavern.getContext().chatId !== chatId) throw new Error('the reopen moved the page'); rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await pause(1500); }; globalThis.__c52 = { pause, until, FACT, codex, known, saved, reopen }; if (known()) throw new Error('the fact shows before the tower is reached'); if (codex().includes('Old Tower')) throw new Error('an unknown place reached the player projection: ' + codex()); return { codex: codex() };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" The road ends at an old tower with a silent bell.

steps.eval: const c = globalThis.__c52; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await c.until(() => rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId === 'tower', 10000, 'the tower checkpoint'); await c.until(() => c.known(), 10000, 'the codex fact to show'); c.reachedAt = rt.getEngineState().lastMessageId; if (c.reachedAt !== SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length - 1) throw new Error('the reaching boundary is not on the last message'); await c.saved(); return { codex: c.codex() };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await globalThis.__c52.pause(800); return { authorView: false };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await globalThis.__c52.pause(800); return { authorView: true };
const c = globalThis.__c52; await c.reopen(); if (!c.known()) throw new Error('the reopen lost the fact'); return { codex: c.codex() };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = ctx.chat.length - 1; if (last !== globalThis.__c52.reachedAt) throw new Error('a message landed after the reaching reply'); const reply = ctx.chat[last]; if (reply.is_user) throw new Error('the reaching message is not a reply'); reply.swipes = [reply.mes, 'The road bends away from the tower and into the woods.']; reply.swipe_id = 0; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); return { swipeable: last };

const c = globalThis.__c52; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await c.until(() => !c.known(), 15000, 'the swipe to take the fact back'); const values = rt.getEngineState().blackboard.values; if (Object.keys(values).some((key) => key.startsWith('codex_l_old-tower') && values[key] !== undefined && values[key] !== null && values[key] !== 0 && values[key] !== false)) throw new Error('a codex latch survived the swipe: ' + JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(values).filter(([k]) => k.startsWith('codex_'))))); if (rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId !== 'camp') throw new Error('the swipe did not rewind the checkpoint: ' + rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId); await c.saved(); return { codex: c.codex(), at: rt.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await globalThis.__c52.pause(800); return { authorView: false };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await globalThis.__c52.pause(800); return { authorView: true };
const c = globalThis.__c52; await c.reopen(); if (c.known()) throw new Error('the reopen re-applied the fact'); return { codex: c.codex() };
